competences.description: Attacks the enemy 3 times and leaves a Branding effect for 2 turns with a 15% chance each. In addition, you attack the enemy one more time if your Attack Power is higher than the enemy target.

effets.description: The target will receive 25% increased damage.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 to 3 times and inflicts Continuous Damage for 2 turns with a 50% chance each.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 3 to 5 times and absorbs their Attack Bar by 20% each. The more harmful effects granted on the target, the higher the chance of inflicting more number of attacks.

effets.description: Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself
